suggested_requirements.text: The system must support authorized entities in creating an electronic information package consisting of required documentation, evidences, proof, attestations, certificates, declarations, and metadata.
The system must collect certificates and attestations from existing registries.
The system must enable the economic operator to add self-declarations or other documents of formal qualification.
The system must enable economic operators to submit the VCD information package to any contracting authority in Europe.
The system must enable contracting authorities or their eTendering systems to interpret and accept the documentation submitted by the economic operator.
The system must provide a pre-VCD mapping tool to support the proof of compliance of evidences of one country to the requested selection and exclusion criteria of another country.
The system must provide a VCD viewing system to allow human-readable access to the VCD package.
The system must implement a VCD transportation system for submitting the VCD to contracting authorities.
VCD Service Providers must be trustworthy, implying that services are precise, up-to-date, available, and reliable.
The system must implement identity and access management to handle roles for authorization and protect sensitive data.
The system must ensure that European legal changes are implemented within five days after enforcement.
The system must use a standard representation of common criteria of qualitative selection and exclusion defined according to Articles 45-50 of Directive 2004/18/EC.
The system must provide a mapping template that ensures comparable and reliable mappings between criteria for qualitative selection and exclusion and national attestations.
The system must ensure that the mapping facility is accessible to all relevant key stakeholders such as economic operators, contracting authorities, certifiers, and national service providers.
